anchor_value: cost/fair value schedule is USD-denominated; EUR/AUD marks Par/Shares only

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Hamilton Thorne, Inc. row shows EUR in the Par/Shares currency position, with Cost 12,293 and Fair Value 11,666 in the valuation columns.
Sonar Acquisitionco, Inc. (dba SimPRO) row shows AUD in the Par/Shares currency position, with Cost 3,682 and Fair Value 3,431 in the valuation columns.

Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Australian Dollars ("AUD"), or Euros ("EUR").

findings.detail: Hamilton Thorne has EUR marked for Par/Shares, but the cost valuation field should remain USD-denominated.
Sonar Acquisitionco has AUD marked for Par/Shares, but the cost valuation field should remain USD-denominated.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error: the source uses EUR/AUD as Par/Shares denomination markers under footnote (4), while the investment schedule cost and fair value columns are USD valuation fields. The extracted cost_currency values U_EUR and U_AUD therefore reflect foreign par currency leaking into the cost currency field.
